rows.backtranslation: RAM for opening and editing the image: about %1$s. The current RAM limit for safe editing: %2$s. Choose a copy smaller than this one.
rows.context_and_review_note: Replaced the lone approximation symbol with azal n (about/an amount of), retaining estimated rather than exact need in ordinary words. Revised available RAM to the current RAM LIMIT for safe editing, which is the policy workingBytes budget, not total available system RAM. Added explicit smaller than this to the copy instruction, rather than merely small. Correct common caller is ImageImport.kt:48; native-work checks at :88–89 and :149–150 use the same two placeholders, with estimated working bytes first and policy limit second. Opening/editing remains a functional decoder/buffer paraphrase. No disk-space, saved-file-size, or guaranteed allocation claim.

The estimate text immediately before this status reports estimated requirements, so the status describes the admission comparison, not a promise of eventual allocation/import success. ImageResizeDialog.kt:45 computes fits using memoryRequirements.accepts; :49 appends the status and :50 enables the button.
